name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Idaho Finger Steaks & Hand-Spun Milkshake (Avoid)
whyItWorks: Deep-fried battered beef strips ("finger steaks") paired with a heavy dairy milkshake pack a double punch of fryer oil and lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the grilled hamburger/cheeseburger or plain hot dog instead of battered deep-fried finger steaks when your gut is sensitive.
watchOuts: Heavy deep-fried batter on finger steaks
